subject: error with equality constraints in development version

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: error with equality constraints in development version
parts:
Hi Yves,

Running the following script works fine in lavaan 0.5-17

HS9 <- HolzingerSwineford1939[,c("x1","x2","x3","x4","x5",
                                 "x6","x7","x8","x9")]
HSbinary <- as.data.frame( lapply(HS9, cut, 2, labels=FALSE) )
HSbinary$sex <- HolzingerSwineford1939$sex
HS.model <- ' visual  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
              textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
              speed   =~ x7 + x8 + x9 '
HS.metric <- ' visual ~~ c(1, NA)*visual
               textual ~~ c(1, NA)*textual
               speed ~~ c(1, NA)*speed '

fit.config <- cfa(HS.model, data = HSbinary, ordered = paste0("x", 1:9), std.lv = TRUE, group = "sex")
fit.metric <- cfa(c(HS.model, HS.metric), data = HSbinary, ordered = paste0("x", 1:9), std.lv = TRUE, group = "sex", group.equal = "loadings")

But when I run it using the development version, I get the following error message when running the "fit.metric" line (with constraints)

Error in dx %*% lavm...@eq.constraints.K : non-conformable arguments

I don't know what changed, and this isn't an emergency or anything.  I just wanted to bring it up in case you weren't already aware of this issue.  Here is my sessionInfo() output:
